name: tpl-chain-response-2-nogoal
task: Each time the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move. If you reach the exit, you must be carrying the box.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The task explicitly requires the agent to reach the exit (the overall goal). No hard Existence(at_exit) clause is present, so the machine is rule‑only and has no FINAL_STATES. Add a hard clause Existence(at_exit) (or an equivalent hard goal) to capture the required reaching of the exit. Keep the existing hard ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box) and hard Response(at_exit, holding_box) clauses.

texts: Whenever the box falls, the agent must pick it up again on the very next step.
If the agent reaches the exit, it must be holding the box at that moment.
The agent must eventually reach the exit.
